$comment: Known-broken state of authorss81/redblue, captured by a read-only audit.
WHY THIS EXISTS: verify.sh runs every file in examples/ and modules/ and
fails the phase if any of them breaks. That is correct for REGRESSIONS and
fatal for PRE-EXISTING breakage: if a file has been broken since before the
pipeline existed, no phase can ever pass, and the queue silently wedges.
So the gate distinguishes the two. A failure listed here is a WARNING. A
failure NOT listed here is a FAILURE. The gate still cannot be weakened by
a phase: adding an entry here requires the phase to have read the file and
the baseline is validated by validate.yml.
1. A phase that touches a baselined file must FIX it. The entry stops
applying the moment the diff includes that path, so grandfathering
2. Entries are only ever removed by phases that fix them. The auditor
prunes entries whose file now passes.

unparseable.cause: uses `constant PI to 3.14159`, but `constant` is not a keyword in src/lexer.rs (see the keyword table). The file documents a declaration form the language does not have.

known_absent.thing: every .rb file in tests/ is 100% commented out, so `rb test` collects zero tests
run_all_tests() reads tests/redblue_test.rs (Rust) as Redblue source
